test_gen_wrappers: test that gen_wrappers script can be executed and generates a .pxi wrapper file
test_deterministic: test that running gen_wrappers twice produces identical output to verify determinism
test_generated: test that generated wrappers match the checked-in wrappers.pxi file in mujoco_py
run_gen_wrappers_script: run the gen_wrappers.py script to generate Cython wrapper bindings for MuJoCo
review_test_gen_wrappers: review the test suite that validates gen_wrappers execution, determinism, and output correctness
